""" # Allowed tags and attributes for the event description and notes. """ # First escape any special HTML characters escaped = html.escape(content, quote=True) return escaped def generate_event_invite( title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event.
